name: lares4-console
description: Desktop debug console for Lares4 panels (Tauri + lares4-ts)
author: Giuseppe Lucio Sorrentino

scripts.test: tsx --test --import ./tests/helpers/dom-setup.ts tests/*.test.ts tests/desktop/*.test.tsx src/pro/macros/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/macros/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/tabs/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/tabs/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/triggers/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/triggers/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/annotations/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/annotations/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/windows/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/windows/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/sessions/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/sessions/__tests__/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && node --import tsx/esm --import ./tests/helpers/dom-setup.ts --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.tsx' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=- --test-reporter-destination=./coverage/lcov.info tests/*.test.ts tests/desktop/*.test.tsx src/pro/macros/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/macros/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/tabs/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/tabs/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/triggers/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/triggers/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/annotations/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/annotations/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/windows/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/windows/__tests__/*.test.tsx src/pro/sessions/__tests__/*.test.ts src/pro/sessions/__tests__/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
